title: Synthetic Credit-Card Portfolio Simulator
summary: A Python simulator that fabricates a synthetic credit-card customer portfolio, fits ML models for spend/default/churn, and runs an agent-based policy simulation with a Streamlit dashboard. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata to generate the synthetic tabular customer dataset that feeds the rest of the pipeline.
